name: memecub
description: Search memes, GIFs and Chinese 表情包 by feeling, and place them into articles
readme:
# memecub **Meme search and automatic meme placement for AI agents.** Give Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or Claude Desktop a meme library. Search reaction memes by feeling, or hand over an article and get it back with the right meme after the right sentence. English · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) [![Website](https://img.shields.io/badge/memecub.com-ffd43b?style=flat-square&logoColor=1d1c1a)](https://memecub.com) [![MCP Registry](https://img.shields.io/badge/MCP_Registry-com.memecub%2Fmemecub-1d1c1a?style=flat-square)](https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/v0/servers?search=com.memecub/memecub) [![Smithery](https://img.shields.io/badge/Smithery-memecub-1d1c1a?style=flat-square)](https://smithery.ai/servers/memecub/memecub) [![Remote MCP](https://img.shields.io/badge/remote_MCP-Streamable_HTTP-1d1c1a?style=flat-square)](#quick-start) [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/memecub?style=flat-square&color=1d1c1a)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/memecub) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/code-MIT-1d1c1a?style=flat-square)](LICENSE)
![Paste an article, get it back with memes: real output of match_article](assets/demo-en.png)

Real output of match_article. The model picks the moments; memecub finds the meme and inserts it as Markdown.

## Why memecub - **It places memes, not just finds them.** `match_article` reads a whole post, picks the sentences worth a meme and returns the article with images inserted. Your agent doesn't have to guess where they go. - **Search by feeling.** Ask for `facepalm`, `this is fine`, `it works on my machine`, `无语` or `摸鱼` and get the reaction you meant, not a keyword lookalike. - **English memes and Chinese 表情包 in one library.** Drake, This Is Fine, Doge and Surprised Pikachu next to 熊猫头, 奶龙, 金馆长, 吗喽 and DeepSeek 鲸鱼娘. Chinese queries match whole phrases, so a character name returns that character. - **Zero install.** A remote MCP server over Streamable HTTP, or a plain-curl Agent Skill. Searching works without a key. - **License-aware results.** Every image says whether it is cleared for commercial use, links its source, and ships a ready Markdown snippet with the credit line when one is required. Ask for commercial-safe only and that's all you get. - **Safe defaults for agents.** Memes whose captions contain swearing are left out of agent results unless you ask for them. ## Quick start **One command, 40+ agents.** Installs the memecub skill into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot, OpenClaw, Trae, Windsurf and any other agent that loads [Agent Skills](#agent-skill): ```bash npx skills add https://memecub.com ``` Prefer MCP? The server is `https://memecub.com/mcp` (Streamable HTTP). Pick your client: **Claude Code** ```bash claude mcp add --transport http memecub https://memecub.com/mcp ``` **Codex** ```bash codex mcp add memecub --url https://memecub.com/mcp ``` **Gemini CLI** ```bash gemini mcp add --transport http memecub https://memecub.com/mcp ``` **Cursor** (`~/.cursor/mcp.json`) ```json { "mcpServers": { "memecub": { "url": "https://memecub.com/mcp" } } } ``` **VS Code** (`.vscode/mcp.json`) ```json { "servers": { "memecub": { "type": "http", "url": "https://memecub.com/mcp" } } } ``` **Claude Desktop / claude.ai**: Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector → `https://memecub.com/mcp` **ChatGPT**: Settings → Apps & Connectors → Advanced → turn on developer mode, then create a connector with `https://memecub.com/mcp` Cherry Studio, Dify, n8n and other clients that take a remote MCP server work the same way. Step-by-step guides for each tool: [memecub.com/developers](https://memecub.com/developers). Then just ask: > Add 3 memes to draft.md where they fit. > > Find me a facepalm meme, commercial use only. > > 给这篇文章配几张表情包。 ## MCP tools | Tool | What it does | |---|---| | `search_memes` | Search by reaction, feeling or character. Filters: `commercial_only`, `no_credit`, `kind` (meme, gif, emoji, artwork, photo), `min_size` | | `match_article` | Read an article, pick the spots that deserve a meme, return the article with images inserted (needs a key) | | `get_meme` | Full details for one image: license, source, author, credit line, tags | | `list_categories` | Library categories | You can try it without a key (20 searches a day per IP). Add `Authorization: Bearer ` (run `npx memecub login`, or create one at [memecub.com/dashboard](https://memecub.com/dashboard?tab=keys)) to use your credits: a free account gets 1,000 a month, a search costs 1 and `match_article` costs 20 per image it places. Plans and credit packs: [memecub.com/pricing](https://memecub.com/pricing). ## Agent skill [`skills/memecub/SKILL.md`](skills/memecub/SKILL.md) teaches an agent to place memes into writing with plain `curl`. No MCP, no dependencies. ```bash npx skills add https://memecub.com # pick your agents interactively npx skills add https://memecub.com -g -a claude-code # or target one: codex, cursor, gemini-cli, openclaw… npx skills add liyupi/memecub # same skill, from this repo ``` memecub.com publishes the skill at [`/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json`](https://memecub.com/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json), so the site URL is enough. Or by hand: ```bash # Claude Code: ~/.claude/skills Codex: ~/.codex/skills Cursor: ~/.cursor/skills mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills/memecub curl -s https://memecub.com/skill.md -o ~/.claude/skills/memecub/SKILL.md ``` ## REST API ```bash curl -sG https://memecub.com/api/v1/search --data-urlencode "q=facepalm" -d limit=1 ``` ```jsonc { "data": [{ "title": "Facepalm", "url": "https://gpic.code-nav.cn/memecub/public/12vw20qg0awo.jpg", "page_url": "https://memecub.com/meme/12vw20qg0awo-facepalm", "width": 679, "height": 600, "kind": "meme", "license": { "code": "web", "commercial_use": false, "attribution_required": false }, "markdown": "![Facepalm](https://gpic.code-nav.cn/memecub/public/12vw20qg0awo.jpg)" }] } ``` All endpoints and limits: [memecub.com/developers](https://memecub.com/developers). ## CLI and JS client [`memecub` on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/memecub), source in [`cli/`](cli). Node 18+. ```bash npx memecub search "facepalm" --limit 5 npm i -g memecub # or install the `memecub` command memecub search "facepalm" --limit 5 memecub search "mind blown" --commercial # only images cleared for commercial use memecub match ./article.md --count 4 > article.with-memes.md ``` ```ts import { MemecubClient } from "memecub"; const client = new MemecubClient("https://memecub.com", process.env.MEMECUB_API_KEY); const { data } = await client.search({ q: "mind blown", limit: 5, commercialOnly: true }); ``` ## The website Everything the agent sees is also browsable at [memecub.com](https://memecub.com): search, topic pages, one-click copy and download, and the article tool in the browser. | Home | Topic page | Agent setup | |---|---|---| | [![memecub home page](assets/home-en.png)](https://memecub.com) | [![Drake memes topic page](assets/topic-en.png)](https://memecub.com/tag/drake) | [![Setup guide for AI agents](assets/developers-en.png)](https://memecub.com/developers) | ## FAQ **Is it free?** Browsing memecub.com is free, and so is light API use: 20 keyless searches a day, or 1,000 credits a month with a free account. Heavier use runs on [plans and credit packs](https://memecub.com/pricing). **Can I use the images commercially?** Check `license.commercial_use` on each result. Memes collected from the web are `false`: copyright belongs to their creators and the source link is kept. Openly licensed images (CC0, public domain, CC BY and similar) are `true` and come with the credit line when the license needs one. Pass `commercial_only: true` (MCP) or `commercial=1` (REST) to get only those. **Is the website open source?** No. This repository holds the integrations (MCP descriptor, Agent Skill, CLI and client). The site and its data pipeline are run by memecub. **Found a problem with an image?** Use the report button on its page, or see [memecub.com/dmca](https://memecub.com/dmca). ## License Code in this repository is [MIT](LICENSE). Images are not covered by MIT; each result carries its own license. If memecub saves your agent a trip to the image search, a ⭐ helps others find it.

<div align="center">

<img src="assets/logo.png" alt="memecub logo" width="88">

memecub

Meme search and automatic meme placement for AI agents.

Give Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or Claude Desktop a meme library. Search reaction memes by feeling, or hand over an article and get it back with the right meme after the right sentence.

English · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

![Website](https://memecub.com)

![MCP Registry](https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/v0/servers?search=com.memecub/memecub)

![Smithery](https://smithery.ai/servers/memecub/memecub)

![Remote MCP](#quick-start)

![npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/memecub)

![License: MIT](LICENSE)

</div>

![Paste an article, get it back with memes: real output of match_article](assets/demo-en.png)

<p align="center"><sub>Real output of <code>match_article</code>. The model picks the moments; memecub finds the meme and inserts it as Markdown.</sub></p>

Why memecub

  • It places memes, not just finds them. match_article reads a whole post, picks the sentences worth a meme and returns the article with images inserted. Your agent doesn't have to guess where they go.
  • Search by feeling. Ask for facepalm, this is fine, it works on my machine, 无语 or 摸鱼 and get the reaction you meant, not a keyword lookalike.
  • English memes and Chinese 表情包 in one library. Drake, This Is Fine, Doge and Surprised Pikachu next to 熊猫头, 奶龙, 金馆长, 吗喽 and DeepSeek 鲸鱼娘. Chinese queries match whole phrases, so a character name returns that character.
  • Zero install. A remote MCP server over Streamable HTTP, or a plain-curl Agent Skill. Searching works without a key.
  • License-aware results. Every image says whether it is cleared for commercial use, links its source, and ships a ready Markdown snippet with the credit line when one is required. Ask for commercial-safe only and that's all you get.
  • Safe defaults for agents. Memes whose captions contain swearing are left out of agent results unless you ask for them.

Quick start

One command, 40+ agents. Installs the memecub skill into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot, OpenClaw, Trae, Windsurf and any other agent that loads [Agent Skills](#agent-skill):


npx skills add https://memecub.com

Prefer MCP? The server is https://memecub.com/mcp (Streamable HTTP). Pick your client:

Claude Code


claude mcp add --transport http memecub https://memecub.com/mcp

Codex


codex mcp add memecub --url https://memecub.com/mcp

Gemini CLI


gemini mcp add --transport http memecub https://memecub.com/mcp

Cursor (~/.cursor/mcp.json)


{ "mcpServers": { "memecub": { "url": "https://memecub.com/mcp" } } }

VS Code (.vscode/mcp.json)


{ "servers": { "memecub": { "type": "http", "url": "https://memecub.com/mcp" } } }

Claude Desktop / claude.ai: Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector → https://memecub.com/mcp

ChatGPT: Settings → Apps & Connectors → Advanced → turn on developer mode, then create a connector with https://memecub.com/mcp

Cherry Studio, Dify, n8n and other clients that take a remote MCP server work the same way. Step-by-step guides for each tool: memecub.com/developers.

Then just ask:

> Add 3 memes to draft.md where they fit.

>

> Find me a facepalm meme, commercial use only.

>

> 给这篇文章配几张表情包。

MCP tools

| Tool | What it does |

|---|---|

| search_memes | Search by reaction, feeling or character. Filters: commercial_only, no_credit, kind (meme, gif, emoji, artwork, photo), min_size |

| match_article | Read an article, pick the spots that deserve a meme, return the article with images inserted (needs a key) |

| get_meme | Full details for one image: license, source, author, credit line, tags |

| list_categories | Library categories |

You can try it without a key (20 searches a day per IP). Add Authorization: Bearer <key> (run npx memecub login, or create one at memecub.com/dashboard) to use your credits: a free account gets 1,000 a month, a search costs 1 and match_article costs 20 per image it places. Plans and credit packs: memecub.com/pricing.

Agent skill

[skills/memecub/SKILL.md](skills/memecub/SKILL.md) teaches an agent to place memes into writing with plain curl. No MCP, no dependencies.


npx skills add https://memecub.com                  # pick your agents interactively

npx skills add https://memecub.com -g -a claude-code  # or target one: codex, cursor, gemini-cli, openclaw…

npx skills add liyupi/memecub                       # same skill, from this repo

memecub.com publishes the skill at /.well-known/agent-skills/index.json, so the site URL is enough.

Or by hand:


# Claude Code: ~/.claude/skills   Codex: ~/.codex/skills   Cursor: ~/.cursor/skills

mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills/memecub

curl -s https://memecub.com/skill.md -o ~/.claude/skills/memecub/SKILL.md

REST API


curl -sG https://memecub.com/api/v1/search --data-urlencode "q=facepalm" -d limit=1



{

  "data": [{

    "title": "Facepalm",

    "url": "https://gpic.code-nav.cn/memecub/public/12vw20qg0awo.jpg",

    "page_url": "https://memecub.com/meme/12vw20qg0awo-facepalm",

    "width": 679, "height": 600, "kind": "meme",

    "license": { "code": "web", "commercial_use": false, "attribution_required": false },

    "markdown": "![Facepalm](https://gpic.code-nav.cn/memecub/public/12vw20qg0awo.jpg)"

  }]

}

All endpoints and limits: memecub.com/developers.

CLI and JS client

memecub on npm, source in [cli/](cli). Node 18+.


npx memecub search "facepalm" --limit 5

npm i -g memecub                                  # or install the `memecub` command

memecub search "facepalm" --limit 5

memecub search "mind blown" --commercial          # only images cleared for commercial use

memecub match ./article.md --count 4 > article.with-memes.md



import { MemecubClient } from "memecub";



const client = new MemecubClient("https://memecub.com", process.env.MEMECUB_API_KEY);

const { data } = await client.search({ q: "mind blown", limit: 5, commercialOnly: true });

The website

Everything the agent sees is also browsable at memecub.com: search, topic pages, one-click copy and download, and the article tool in the browser.

| Home | Topic page | Agent setup |

|---|---|---|

| [![memecub home page](assets/home-en.png)](https://memecub.com) | [![Drake memes topic page](assets/topic-en.png)](https://memecub.com/tag/drake) | [![Setup guide for AI agents](assets/developers-en.png)](https://memecub.com/developers) |

FAQ

Is it free? Browsing memecub.com is free, and so is light API use: 20 keyless searches a day, or 1,000 credits a month with a free account. Heavier use runs on plans and credit packs.

Can I use the images commercially? Check license.commercial_use on each result. Memes collected from the web are false: copyright belongs to their creators and the source link is kept. Openly licensed images (CC0, public domain, CC BY and similar) are true and come with the credit line when the license needs one. Pass commercial_only: true (MCP) or commercial=1 (REST) to get only those.

Is the website open source? No. This repository holds the integrations (MCP descriptor, Agent Skill, CLI and client). The site and its data pipeline are run by memecub.

Found a problem with an image? Use the report button on its page, or see memecub.com/dmca.

License

Code in this repository is [MIT](LICENSE). Images are not covered by MIT; each result carries its own license.

If memecub saves your agent a trip to the image search, a ⭐ helps others find it.
